exactBlockers: Sandbox has no egress to Kalshi, MLB Stats API, or The Odds API: every acquisition runs in GitHub Actions.

A new workflow_dispatch workflow is not dispatchable until its file exists on the default branch (research-kalshi-history-recovery.yml returned 404); recovery is being run through the registered generic research-sharp-market-probe.yml (45-min runs, per-branch concurrency => sequential resumable rounds).
The Odds API quota: full August Pinnacle at 15-min (h2h+totals) ~24k credits vs 18,100 remaining -- needs CEO decision (or h2h-only at 30-min ~5k).
No lineup/pitcher confirmation timestamps exist historically; only prospective capture can test information-event lag.
Kalshi order-book depth has no history endpoint; prospective only.
Hitter-family production probabilities are null in model_evaluations; Family E cannot test hitter props.
